name: @dimm-city/print-md-viewer
author: itlackey
description: Desktop viewer for print-md (Electron + SvelteKit adapter-node app, served via app:// + fetch API routes).

scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && vite build && node ../../tools/check-render-purity.mjs build/client --strict
scripts.test: svelte-kit sync && node tests/pagedjs-interface.test.mjs && node tests/preview-bridge.test.mjs && bun test --isolate tests/updater tests/platform tests/recovery tests/editor tests/media
scripts.electron:build: electron-vite build && node --check out/main/main.js && node --check out/preload/preload.cjs
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron out/main/main.js
scripts.electron:hmr: npm run electron:build && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite dev --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron out/main/main.js"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
